title: Failed proactive OCR task bypasses the intended on-demand fallback
reasoning: The coordinator waits for an in-flight proactive OCR task and only handles asyncio.TimeoutError. If that task fails with any other exception, the exception propagates immediately and the code never reaches the on-demand OCR fallback. This contradicts the fallback path's stated role for cases where proactive OCR is disabled, failed, or unavailable, and can turn a recoverable proactive-task failure into a user-visible failure even when ocr_service.perform_ocr(screenshot_data) would succeed.
reproduction: Set ocr_state.get_active_task(screenshot_id) to return a task that raises RuntimeError, while the OCR service is enabled and perform_ocr would return valid results. get_ocr_results raises RuntimeError instead of running the fallback OCR path.
recommendation: Catch proactive-task failures separately from timeout, log them, and continue into the existing cache check and on-demand OCR path. Preserve cancellation semantics by not swallowing asyncio.CancelledError unless there is an explicit reason to do so.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included, and the excerpt has no coverage demonstrating behavior when the proactive OCR task raises before cached OCR results are available.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a coordinator test with an active OCR task that raises a non-cancellation exception and an enabled fake OCR service; assert that get_ocr_results returns the fallback service result and logs or records the proactive failure.
minimumFixScope: Update the active_ocr_task wait block in OcrCoordinator.get_ocr_results and add one focused failure-path test.
